تختبرن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِرْنَ (taḵtabirna) /tax.ta.bir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# تُخْتَبَرْنَ (tuḵtabarna) /tux.ta.bar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
